title: Object brutally hurt in building next to the highway
content:
# Object brutally hurt in building 200 meters west of Crazy Creek Falls
 Today, in the morning, an object called Circly got thrown in a white room. He was then hurt by [a certain person on Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/user/Fun-Committee-7104/)
 Authorities found him bleeding out with his arm ripped off in a white building near Crazy Creek Falls. The suspect had fleed far away. If you have any information about the suspect, please contact us at arthur.greghi2105@gmail.com.
 The suspect is a Panama hat, he is 6 feet tall. We have no more information.
 The weapon of the crime, a **force manipulator** and a **knife** were used to cut him and rip off his arm.
 Here, our journalist, Compass, asked Dementy:
 Compass: Dementy what do you think of this ridiculous case?! Dementy said; This is *so* unacceptable! I thought **our** town was peaceful, and not violent! We really have to get a hold on these *fucking* criminals, or else our whole town will get destroyed by them!
 That's all for today, and have a good afternoon.

title: Mysterious fountains have appeared in many locations around New Yoyle City
content: # BREAKING NEWS: Mysterious fountains have appeared in many locations around New Yoyle City each day, and no one knows who’s causing it. People speculated this might be The Prophecy unfolding, which means The Roaring isn’t too far. Luckily, The Prophecy states that three heroes will save the world, so there’s not that much to worry about! In fact, three objects have been seen running to the locations where the fountains are, so they must be the heroes. As of right now, they are in the fifth fountain location, A.K.A the Crystal Shop. That’s all for now
